sections.Profile:
"One-Two-Three," released by Genco Manufacturing Co. in October 1948, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine. The game features a city skyline theme, with the backglass depicting a somewhat futuristic cityscape complete with a water fountain and surrounding trees. The playfield is equipped with two flippers, six scoring bumpers, and three kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Genco Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, City, Original Theme
